sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Bạn có thể đi cùng tôi được không? asks someone to do one helpful action for you. Use it for come with me when pointing, showing your phone, or giving a document will make the request easy to understand.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Say Bạn có thể đi cùng tôi được không? once, then make the task visible with your phone screen, receipt, item, photo, or the place where the issue is happening. The phrase is doing one job: getting a clear answer about come with me.

sections.body: Use this in a real problem-solving exchange when come with me is the detail you need resolved. The likely reply is yes/no, a helpful action, or a short instruction, so keep the phrase short and ready for one follow-up.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: This phrase can sound warm when the request is small and your tone is calm. A visible phone screen, receipt, or booking helps the other person answer without a long explanation.
